title: Language AI Lab
tagline: Teach a computer to understand words
objectives: Explain what Natural Language Processing is
Tell understanding tasks from generating tasks
See how a rule-based chatbot picks replies
Clean messy training labels for a sentiment AI

stages.title: Meet Language AI!
stages.narration: Human language is messy, full of slang, typos, and feelings. Natural Language Processing helps computers read, understand, and write our words. Let's explore how!

steps.text: You type or speak a message…
The AI breaks it into words and patterns.
It works out what you actually mean.
Then it replies in language you understand.

stages.title: Spot the Language AI
stages.prompt: Tap everything that uses Natural Language Processing to work with human words.

feedback.correct: Yes! This works with human language, that's NLP.
feedback.incorrect: This doesn't read or understand words, so it isn't NLP.

stages.title: Understanding vs Generating
stages.prompt: Some NLP tasks make sense of language coming IN. Others create new language going OUT. Sort each one.
stages.note: Understanding = making sense of words coming in. Generating = producing brand-new words.

cards.label: Tell if a review is happy or angry
Suggest the next word as you type

stages.title: Build a Rule-Based Chatbot
stages.prompt: A simple chatbot matches your message to a rule, then replies. Which reply should fire for each message?

tasks.label: "Hello there!"
tasks.explain: The message contains 'hello', so the greeting rule fires.

tasks.label: "Can I get a hint for question 3?"
tasks.explain: It asks for a hint, so the hint rule replies with a small clue.

tasks.label: "Got any study tips?"
tasks.explain: It mentions tips, so the study-tip rule responds.

tasks.label: "Hi! 😊"
tasks.explain: A greeting word triggers the friendly hello reply.

tasks.label: "I need a clue to solve this"
tasks.explain: Asking for a clue matches the hint rule.

stages.title: Clean the Sentiment Data
stages.prompt: You're training an AI to tell happy reviews from angry ones. Some reviews are mislabeled and will confuse it. Tap the wrong ones to toss them out. Watch the accuracy meter!
stages.note: A happy face labeled 'Negative' teaches the AI the wrong lesson. Correct labels are everything.
stages.explain: Once every review was labeled correctly, accuracy hit 100%. Clean labels make a smart language model.

stages.title: Language AI Final Test
stages.prompt: Score at least 80% to earn your Language Whiz badge.

questions.explain: NLP = Natural Language Processing, helping computers work with human language.
Translation is a classic NLP task, along with text generation and sentiment analysis.

questions.q: Deciding if a review is happy or angry is called...
questions.explain: Sentiment analysis reads the feeling behind the words.

questions.q: How does a rule-based chatbot pick a reply?
options: It matches your message to patterns
questions.explain: It looks for patterns ('if it contains hint...') and responds accordingly.

questions.q: Turning your voice into text is...
questions.explain: Speech recognition converts spoken words into written text.
Voice assistants use NLP to understand your words and reply.

questions.q: Why fix wrong labels in training data?
questions.explain: Garbage labels in, garbage predictions out. Clean data matters most.

stages.title: Lab Complete!
messages: 🏆 You earned the Language Whiz Badge
You taught a computer to understand words
